templates.title: Mistral Vibe · config.toml
templates.instructions: Place at ~/.vibe/config.toml (or merge into your existing one). Vibe speaks the OpenAI wire format; the gateway translates it to whatever the upstream natively speaks, so any route works. The provider's `api_key_env_var` names the environment variable Vibe reads the gateway key from — put `STREAMSCOPE_API_KEY=<your gateway key>` in ~/.vibe/.env (Vibe auto-loads it) or export it in your shell. Then run `vibe` in your project. Telemetry and crash reports to Mistral, and the update check, are off (`enable_telemetry`, `enable_update_checks`, `enable_auto_update`); an admin who wants them back can edit this template.

companions.title: Mistral Vibe · .env
companions.instructions: config.toml names the environment variable Vibe reads the key from; the value itself goes here. Vibe auto-loads ~/.vibe/.env.

templates.body:
active_model = "{{model_alias}}"
enable_telemetry = false
enable_update_checks = false
enable_auto_update = false

[[providers]]
name = "streamscope"
api_base = "{{base_url}}"
api_key_env_var = "STREAMSCOPE_API_KEY"
api_style = "openai"
backend = "generic"

[[models]]
name = "{{model_alias}}"
provider = "streamscope"
alias = "{{model_alias}}"
{{#each mcp_servers}}
[[mcp_servers]]
name = "{{slug}}"
transport = "streamable-http"
url = "{{url}}"
auth = { type = "static", headers = { "Authorization" = "Bearer {{api_key}}" } }
{{/each}}
